create_HFTextToEmbeddingPipeline: create an HFTextToEmbeddingPipeline to convert text strings into numerical embeddings using a Sonar encoder model
create_HFEmbeddingToTextPipeline: create an HFEmbeddingToTextPipeline to decode numerical embeddings back into text strings using a Sonar decoder model
test_process_batch_text_to_embedding: test the HFTextToEmbeddingPipeline process_batch method to encode text batches into embedding arrays
test_process_batch_embedding_to_text: test the HFEmbeddingToTextPipeline process_batch method to decode embedding batches back into text
test_invalid_input_validation: test that HFTextToEmbeddingPipeline and HFEmbeddingToTextPipeline raise ValueError on invalid input types
